page_title: MAL 1-0 SEV | Mallorca v Sevilla 09/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Oliver Torres (Sevilla) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Predrag Rajkovic intercepts the ball.
90+5' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the left post.
90+3' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
90+3' Kike Salas (Sevilla) commits a foul and Javier Alberola Rojas immediately signals a free kick.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
89' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
89' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
88' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Mallorca will take a corner kick.
88' The manager makes a subsitution with Kike Salas (Sevilla) coming on for Adria Pedrosa.
85' Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) receives the ball and has a go from distance, but he shouldn't have bothered as it sails high over the bar.
84' Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
84' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
83' Djibril Sow comes off the pitch to be replaced by Oliver Torres (Sevilla).

83' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Marko Dmitrovic leaps like a salmon to deny him.
81' Javier Aguirre prepares a substitution. Daniel Rodriguez is replaced by Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca).
81' That will be all from Sergi Darder who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Manu Morlanes (Mallorca).
80' Samu Costa (Mallorca) tries to find Sergi Darder, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.

79' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) latches onto a pass and lets rip with a swerving shot from long range towards the bottom left corner. It's a difficult effort to deal with and Predrag Rajkovic does well to punch it away.
75' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
75' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) takes the corner which is cleared.
74' Boubakary Soumare (Sevilla) makes a really bad tackle on his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
74' Toni Lato lays the ball off to Sergi Darder (Mallorca), who hurriedly shoots from long range and sends the ball high over the bar into row Z.
69' Jaume Costa goes off the pitch and Toni Lato (Mallorca) comes on.
69' Javier Aguirre has decided to substitute Martin Valjent and he is replaced by Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca).
68' Jaume Costa (Mallorca) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
64' The substitution has been made. Abdon Prats (Mallorca) has replaced Cyle Larin.
63' The goal by Sevilla is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a handball.
63' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was a handball in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Sevilla players aren’t happy.
62' Goal! Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot inside the left post. It's 1:1.
60' Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the underside of the crossbar is perfectly saved by the goalkeeper.
60' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) is about to take a corner kick.
60' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick.
59' Adnan Januzaj (Sevilla) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
58' Jaume Costa (Mallorca) brings an opponent down and Javier Alberola Rojas interrupts the game. A free kick has been awarded to Sevilla.
55' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
55' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) has an effort from distance but it's blocked.
54' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
50' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
50' Samu Costa (Mallorca) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
49' Nemanja Gudelj puts Adnan Januzaj (Sevilla) in the clear, but he completely fluffs his lines from mid-range and sends a shot well wide of the left post.
48' The attendance for today's match is 16041.
46' Samu Costa (Mallorca) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Javier Alberola Rojas blows for a foul.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' Javier Alberola Rojas has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the left post.
45+3' The corner is swung in but Sevilla can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45+2' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.

45+2' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going into the roof of the net, but Predrag Rajkovic has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
45+1' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
43' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) sends a cross into the box, but Predrag Rajkovic comes off his line to gather the ball.
43' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) takes a short corner kick.
43' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Sevilla win a corner.
41' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) swings it in and Samu Costa gets on the end of it, but Marko Dmitrovic shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
37' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Predrag Rajkovic has no trouble gathering it.

37' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Predrag Rajkovic dived superbly to block a header by Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) from around the penalty spot. His effort was directed straight towards the left post, but Predrag Rajkovic pulled off a remarkable save!
36' Samu Costa (Mallorca) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Sevilla win a free kick.
35' Mallorca couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Marko Dmitrovic (Sevilla) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
34' Dangerous play by Sergio Ramos (Sevilla). Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Mallorca.
33' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) has picked up an injury and is replaced by Adnan Januzaj.
32' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
31' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
29' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
26' What a miskick by Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
24' Wasted effort! Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) received a nice pass in space from Dodi Lukebakio, but his long-range shot was weak and floated well wide of the right post.
23' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) finds himself some space around the penalty spot to connect with a fine free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches over the bar.

22' Boubakary Soumare (Sevilla) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Javier Alberola Rojas stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. A free kick is awarded to Mallorca.
21' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) spurns a big chance! He makes himself some space to meet a cross and from near the penalty spot sends a header well wide of the left post!
21' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) will take the corner.
19' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Sevilla.
19' An attempted cross from Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) is cleared. The ball is out of play. Sevilla will have a chance to score from a corner.
18' Mallorca are ruled offside.
17' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) connects with the resulting free kick on the edge of the box, but can't find the target as his effort goes high over the bar.
16' Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle after Djibril Sow (Sevilla) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Mallorca have been awarded a free kick.

11' 1 - 0 Brilliant finish! Cyle Larin (Mallorca) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Samu Costa, then produced a nice strike into the bottom right corner. The score is 1:0.
10' The resulting corner from Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
9' Jaume Costa (Mallorca) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Mallorca force their opponents to concede a corner.
7' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
5' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) gets the ball from a rebound and thumps a terrific long-range shot towards the net. Unfortunately for him, it sails narrowly wide of the left post. Unlucky finish.
5' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

4' Great save! Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Predrag Rajkovic. The referee blows his whistle, Sevilla are awarded a corner kick.
3' The corner from Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) is cleared away by the defence.
3' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Mallorca.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Sevilla will have the kick-off.
Javier Alberola Rojas was nominated as the referee for this game.
